data.name: CacheAdventure
data.detailed_description:
🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

**Cache Chronicles** is a brand-new open-world adventure sandbox game 🌍🎮

Excavate⛏️, build🔨, explore🗺️, and battle⚔️ within the vast, procedurally-generated voxel-based terrain!!! Featuring our uniquely self-developed terrain generation🌱🔄 framework and combat⚔️💥 system framework, enjoy complete terrain destructibility and construction with ultimate freedom 🪄✨. The game🎮 demo is currently in production and is expected to be 💎released💎 this very month! The developer will continue to update the demo for free until the official version launches!!! 🚀📅

We promise that the official release will be built upon this core framework, featuring a complete multi-world storyline👑📖, over 20 distinct ecosystems and terrains 🌲🏜️❄️🌋, more than 100 collectible creatures🐉🦅🐾🦋🧚, over 50 unique skills and 20 creature elements ⚡🔥🌊💨. Plus, arm yourself with over 50 different weapons🗡️🛡️🏹🔫💣 and equipment🛡️🪄🔧🪓⚒️🎩. And that's not all—many more gameplay styles await! 🎪🎲🎯

Stay tuned!!! ✨🌟🎉

🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

Dude, why'd you scroll so far down? 📏⬇️

Wanna hear me geek out about the story? Hehe. 😜 For real though!!! Even if the intro was a bit hyper, I'm totally pumped to share more in that same hyped-up style!!! 💬🎤

About the game name 🏷️

"Cache" is... well, Cache. It means a storage buffer, a cache 💾. But what kind of cache? Not computer cache, but the cache of the *old world* 🗃️🌌.

Yep, the plot goes something like this: the original physical universe was destroyed 💥, leaving behind only a pile of cached data... 📊🧩

Our protagonist is one fragment of that data 👤, but they bear no grand destiny to save the world 🏋️. This world itself is generated by mathematical rules from that cached data ➗🧮. The protagonist isn't a being from the true physical world and has no obligation to save it!!! 😏🆓

So the choice is in the player's hands 🎮. If you want to uncover what the "secrets" of the past truly are 🕵️, you can follow the hidden narrative threads and gradually piece together the truth of this world 🔍🌌. Or, you can completely ignore the plot and treat the entire world as your own playground to shape and enjoy as you please!!! 🏗️🎨😄

data.short_description: CacheAdventure is a new open-world adventure sandbox game. Dig, explore, fight, loot, and build in infinite procedural landscapes. Enjoy persistent free updates/optimizations—more playable content coming!
data.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Ukrainian, Russian, Japanese, Thai, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Romanian, Vietnamese, Korean

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows-compatible audio device
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700 / AMD Ryzen 5 5500
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT / INTEL Arc A750
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows-compatible audio device
